in_hebrew.name: יניקה
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים הוא חנני - God is gracious
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם יניקה מקורו בשפה העברית ומשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא חנני' או 'חנינת אלוהים'. הוא נגזר מהמילה 'חנן', שפירושה 'לרחם' או 'להיות חנון'. השם יניקה מביע את הרעיון של חסד אלוהים והוא קשור לנושא הגאולה והישועה הנמצאים במרכז המסורת היהודית והנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Γιάνικα
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός ελεήμων - God is merciful
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γιάνικα έχει τις ρίζες του στην εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός ελεήμων' ή 'Το έλεος του Θεού'. Είναι παράγωγο της λέξης 'חנן' (chanan), που σημαίνει 'να ελεέω' ή 'να είμαι ελεήμων'. Το όνομα Γιάνικα αντανακλά την έννοια της θείας συμπόνιας και συνδέεται με τα θέματα της λύτρωσης και της σωτηρίας, που είναι κεντρικά στην εβραϊκή και χριστιανική παράδοση.

in_latin.name: Janika
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Janika originem in lingua hebraica habet et significat 'Deus miseretur' vel 'Misericordia Dei'. Derivatur a verbo 'חנן' (chanan), quod significat 'misereri' vel 'misericordem esse'. Nomen Janika exprimit notionem misericordiae divinae et coniungitur cum thematibus redemptionis et salvationis, quae centralia sunt in traditione christiana.

in_english.name: Janika
in_english.meaning: God is gracious or God has mercy
in_english.long_meaning: The name Janika originates from the Hebrew language and means 'God is gracious' or 'God has mercy'. It is derived from the Hebrew word 'חנן' (chanan), which means 'to be gracious' or 'to show mercy'. The name Janika reflects the concept of divine mercy and is associated with themes of redemption and salvation, central to both Jewish and Christian traditions. It symbolizes a connection to God's benevolence and compassion.

Grace is an unmerited favor or blessing from God, available to all who believe in Him and His love. This spiritual significance not only imbues the name with a sense of reverence but also anchors it to the profound foundation of Christian theology -- the belief in God's boundless grace and mercy. So, every time someone is named Janika, they are subtly reminded of God's love and grace from the very beginning.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Janika: God is gracious and merciful, bestowing blessings upon the namebearer. Like a blossoming flower in spring, Janika embodies the divine grace and love of God. May the name Janika inspire its bearer to live a life filled with compassion, forgiveness, and divine blessings.
